description_en: Deletes a global IP address whitelist template
kebab_example: aliyun dds delete-global-security-ip-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-security-group-id g-qxieqf40xjst1ngpr3jz --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteGlobalSecurityIPGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the latest list of regions
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP address whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

It must be 2 to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

长度为2~120个字符
parameters.name: global_ig_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP address whitelist template
parameters.name: global_security_group_id
